content.value: The Media plugin manages media assets and collections, with discovery, all behind the standard plugin highway.

— finding and surfacing assets across the Content Model. Assets are stored as data the plugin contributes; it never paints its own UI, since it rides the Plugin Behaviour highway and lets the host surfaces (LiveView Studio, the Web Demo) render them.

When a Document points at an asset through a Reference Field, that link is a real edge in the Content Graph. The Media plugin may contribute those reference edges via an Edge Extractor, which the Edge Projector folds into the Content Edges Table — so an image and every document that uses it become connected nodes in the Graph View. Deleting a heavily-referenced asset becomes a visible Blast Radius.

With the Media plugin off, Barkpark still works — the Fresh Install Invariant holds. Core content and core reference edges keep flowing whether or not media is enabled. The plugin loads inside the Phoenix API like its siblings, including the Frt plugin.
